title.zh: 腎臟與泌尿生殖問題（兒科）

overview.en: Pediatric renal and genitourinary disorders: UTI, glomerulonephritis, nephrotic syndrome, hemolytic-uremic syndrome, vesicoureteral reflux, enuresis, and congenital genital/urinary anomalies (cryptorchidism, hypospadias/epispadias, bladder exstrophy).
overview.zh: 兒童腎臟與泌尿生殖疾病：泌尿道感染、腎絲球腎炎、腎病症候群、溶血性尿毒症候群、膀胱輸尿管逆流、遺尿，以及先天性泌尿生殖異常（隱睪症、尿道下裂/上裂、膀胱外翻）。

points.en: Bacteria from skin or gut flora invade the urinary tract.
points.zh: 皮膚或腸道菌叢細菌侵入泌尿道。

points.en: Uncircumcised infants have higher UTI risk than circumcised infants.
points.zh: 未包皮環切的嬰兒UTI風險較高。

points.en: Teach front-to-back wiping; asymptomatic bacteriuria can occur, so screen and treat when infection is suspected.
points.zh: 教導由前往後擦拭；可能有無症狀菌尿，懷疑感染時須篩檢並治療。

points.en: Immune (antigen-antibody) inflammatory injury of glomeruli, typically after group A beta-hemolytic strep: pharyngitis 1-2 weeks before, or skin infection 3-6 weeks before.
points.zh: 腎絲球之免疫（抗原抗體）發炎損傷，多見於A群乙型溶血性鏈球菌感染後：咽炎後1-2週，或皮膚感染後3-6週。

points.en: Findings: periorbital/facial edema worse in the morning, decreased urine, cola-colored urine (hematuria), hypertension, proteinuria, elevated BUN/creatinine, elevated ASO titer.
points.zh: 表現：晨間較明顯的眼周/臉部水腫、尿量減少、可樂色尿（血尿）、高血壓、蛋白尿、BUN/肌酸酐上升、ASO升高。

points.en: Complications: kidney failure, hypertensive encephalopathy, pulmonary edema, heart failure, seizures.
points.zh: 併發症：腎衰竭、高血壓腦病變、肺水腫、心衰竭、癲癇。

points.en: Care: VS, I&O, urine characteristics, daily weight (same time, scale, clothing), limited activity, sodium (and potassium if oliguric) restriction, diuretics, antihypertensives, antibiotics for persistent strep, seizure precautions.
points.zh: 照護：生命徵象、I&O、尿液性狀、每日體重（同時間、同磅秤、同衣著）、限制活動、限鈉（少尿時限鉀）、利尿劑、降壓藥、持續鏈球菌感染給抗生素、癲癇防護。

points.en: Daily weight is the most useful measure of fluid balance; teach parents to treat sore throat, URI and skin infections promptly.
points.zh: 每日體重是評估體液平衡最有用的方法；教導家長及早處理喉嚨痛、上呼吸道與皮膚感染。

points.en: Classic tetrad: massive proteinuria, hypoalbuminemia, hyperlipidemia, edema.
points.zh: 典型四聯：大量蛋白尿、低白蛋白血症、高血脂、水腫。

points.en: Findings: weight gain, periorbital edema worse in morning, leg/labial/scrotal edema, ascites, dark frothy urine, normal or low BP, lethargy, pallor.
points.zh: 表現：體重增加、晨間眼周水腫、腿/陰唇/陰囊水腫、腹水、深色泡沫尿、血壓正常或偏低、倦怠、蒼白。

points.en: Goals: reduce urinary protein loss, reduce edema, prevent infection.
points.zh: 目標：減少尿蛋白流失、減輕水腫、預防感染。

points.en: Treatment: corticosteroids started at diagnosis, immunosuppressants for relapse/non-response, diuretics, salt-poor albumin for severe edema; sodium restriction during massive edema.
points.zh: 治療：確診即開始類固醇；復發/無反應加免疫抑制劑；利尿劑；嚴重水腫用低鹽白蛋白；大量水腫時限鈉。

points.en: Monitor urine specific gravity and protein; teach home urine protein testing, infection signs, avoiding infectious contacts.
points.zh: 監測尿比重與蛋白；教導居家尿蛋白檢測、感染徵象、避免接觸感染者。

points.en: Acute kidney injury in infants and children 6 months-5 years, linked to bacterial toxins, chemicals and viruses.
points.zh: 6個月至5歲嬰幼兒的急性腎損傷，與細菌毒素、化學物質、病毒有關。

points.en: Triad: hemolytic anemia, thrombocytopenia, kidney failure; also CNS signs, hemorrhagic findings, oliguria/anuria.
points.zh: 三聯徵：溶血性貧血、血小板低下、腎衰竭；並有中樞神經症狀、出血表現、少尿/無尿。

points.en: Labs: high BUN/creatinine, low Hgb/Hct, high reticulocytes, proteinuria, hematuria, casts.
points.zh: 檢驗：BUN/肌酸酐高、Hgb/Hct低、網狀紅血球高、蛋白尿、血尿、尿圓柱。

points.en: Care: strict fluid balance, fluid restriction if anuric, dialysis if worsening, infection prevention, nutrition, blood transfusion cautiously to avoid fluid overload.
points.zh: 照護：嚴格體液平衡、無尿時限水、惡化時透析、預防感染、營養、謹慎輸血避免液體過量。

points.en: Urine flows backward from bladder to ureters/kidneys; primary type from faulty ureter-bladder valve, secondary from bladder outlet blockage.
points.zh: 尿液由膀胱逆流至輸尿管/腎臟；原發性為輸尿管膀胱瓣膜缺陷，續發性為膀胱出口阻塞。

points.en: Risk: bladder exstrophy, family history, neurogenic bladder (e.g., spina bifida).
points.zh: 危險因子：膀胱外翻、家族史、神經性膀胱（如脊柱裂）。

points.en: Diagnosis: ultrasound, voiding cystourethrogram; recurrent UTI is the common presentation.
points.zh: 診斷：超音波、排尿性膀胱尿道攝影；常見表現為反覆UTI。

points.en: Treatment: prophylactic antibiotics, Deflux injection, or surgical repair; teach fluids, avoid juice/soda, warm towel for discomfort.
points.zh: 治療：預防性抗生素、Deflux注射或手術修補；教導多喝水、避免果汁與汽水、溫毛巾緩解不適。

points.en: Many children outgrow mild primary reflux as the ureterovesical junction matures; surgery is reserved for severe or persistent reflux to protect the kidneys.
points.zh: 輕度原發性逆流常隨輸尿管膀胱接口發育成熟而自行緩解；嚴重或持續的逆流才需手術以保護腎臟。

points.en: Diagnosed in children older than 5 who wet at least twice weekly for 3 months; the child cannot control it.
points.zh: 5歲以上、每週至少2次且持續3個月的尿濕；孩子無法控制。

points.en: Primary: never dry; nocturnal enuresis is common and usually outgrown. Secondary: wetting after established continence; check for UTI, diabetes.
points.zh: 原發性：從未乾爽；夜間遺尿常見，多會自行好轉。續發性：已控制後又發生；需排除UTI、糖尿病。

points.en: Daytime (diurnal) enuresis is a separate category from nighttime wetting; daytime wetting after toilet training also warrants the same infection/pathology workup.
points.zh: 白天（晝間）遺尿是與夜間尿床不同的獨立類別；完成如廁訓練後仍有白天漏尿，同樣需評估感染或病理原因。

points.en: Care: urinalysis/culture, limit fluids at night, void before bed, reward systems, conditioning (alarms), desmopressin or anticholinergics.
points.zh: 照護：尿液分析/培養、夜間限水、睡前排尿、獎勵制度、行為制約（警報器）、desmopressin或抗膽鹼藥。

points.en: One or both testes not descended into the scrotum; not palpable or easily guided down.
points.zh: 單側或雙側睪丸未下降至陰囊；摸不到或無法輕易推入。

points.en: Observe for spontaneous descent in the first 6 months; surgical correction (orchiopexy) usually at 6-12 months.
points.zh: 前6個月觀察是否自然下降；睪丸固定術通常於6-12個月進行。

points.en: Postop: monitor bleeding, infection, pain; teach home care and activity limits; offer counseling about fertility.
points.zh: 術後：監測出血、感染、疼痛；教導居家照護與活動限制；提供生育力諮詢。

points.en: Epispadias: urethral opening on dorsal penis (often with bladder exstrophy). Hypospadias: opening on ventral side below glans.
points.zh: 尿道上裂：開口在陰莖背側（常伴膀胱外翻）。尿道下裂：開口在龜頭下腹側。

points.en: Do not circumcise newborns; foreskin may be needed for repair. Surgery at 6-12 months, before toilet training.
points.zh: 新生兒勿行包皮環切，包皮可能用於重建。手術於6-12個月，在如廁訓練前進行。

points.en: Postop: pressure dressing, stent/diversion, encourage fluids, monitor I&O, report no urine for 1 hour (kinked stent or sediment), anticholinergics for bladder spasms, antibiotics, no tub bath until stent removed.
points.zh: 術後：加壓敷料、導管/支架、鼓勵飲水、監測I&O、1小時無尿須通報（支架扭曲或沉積物）、抗膽鹼藥治膀胱痙攣、抗生素、支架拔除前不盆浴。

points.en: Bladder protrudes through a lower abdominal wall defect; epispadias and vesicoureteral reflux are associated; closure in first days of life.
points.zh: 膀胱經下腹壁缺損外露；伴尿道上裂與膀胱輸尿管逆流；出生後數日內閉合。

points.en: Protect exposed mucosa with sterile nonadherent covering (e.g., plastic wrap) to keep it moist; never petroleum jelly or dry gauze.
points.zh: 以無菌不沾黏敷料（如塑膠膜）覆蓋保持濕潤；不可用凡士林或乾紗布。

points.en: Monitor urine output, infection, renal labs; give antibiotics; support parents.
points.zh: 監測尿量、感染、腎功能檢驗；給抗生素；支持家長。

points.en: STI screening for selected children/adolescents follows CDC guidelines.
points.zh: 特定兒童與青少年依CDC指引進行STI篩檢。

critical_points.en: Glomerulonephritis follows group A strep (pharyngitis 1-2 weeks; skin 3-6 weeks): cola-colored urine, periorbital edema, hypertension, high ASO.
critical_points.zh: 腎絲球腎炎發生於A群鏈球菌感染後（咽炎1-2週；皮膚3-6週）：可樂色尿、眼周水腫、高血壓、ASO升高。

critical_points.en: Daily weight (same time, scale, clothing) is the best measure of fluid balance.
critical_points.zh: 每日體重（同時間、同磅秤、同衣著）是評估體液平衡最佳指標。

critical_points.en: Glomerulonephritis complications: hypertensive encephalopathy, seizures, pulmonary edema, heart failure, kidney failure.
critical_points.zh: 腎絲球腎炎併發症：高血壓腦病變、癲癇、肺水腫、心衰竭、腎衰竭。

critical_points.en: Nephrotic syndrome: massive proteinuria, hypoalbuminemia, hyperlipidemia, edema; BP normal or low (unlike GN).
critical_points.zh: 腎病症候群：大量蛋白尿、低白蛋白、高血脂、水腫；血壓正常或偏低（不同於腎絲球腎炎）。

critical_points.en: Nephrotic syndrome: steroids immediately at diagnosis, watch for infection; teach urine protein testing.
critical_points.zh: 腎病症候群：確診即給類固醇，注意感染；教導尿蛋白檢測。

critical_points.en: HUS triad: hemolytic anemia, thrombocytopenia, acute kidney injury; ages 6 months-5 years.
critical_points.zh: HUS三聯徵：溶血性貧血、血小板低下、急性腎損傷；好發6個月至5歲。

critical_points.en: Anuric HUS child: restrict fluids, restrict potassium; transfuse cautiously; PD does not need an AV fistula.
critical_points.zh: 無尿HUS兒童：限水、限鉀；謹慎輸血；腹膜透析不需動靜脈瘻管。

critical_points.en: Vesicoureteral reflux presents as recurrent UTI; diagnose with voiding cystourethrogram.
critical_points.zh: 膀胱輸尿管逆流表現為反覆UTI；以排尿性膀胱尿道攝影診斷。

critical_points.en: Enuresis: evaluate for UTI/diabetes first; nocturnal enuresis is usually outgrown; desmopressin or anticholinergic may help.
critical_points.zh: 遺尿：先排除UTI/糖尿病；夜間遺尿多會自行好轉；desmopressin或抗膽鹼藥可輔助。

critical_points.en: Cryptorchidism: watch 6 months; orchiopexy at 6-12 months.
critical_points.zh: 隱睪症：觀察6個月；6-12個月行睪丸固定術。

critical_points.en: Hypospadias/epispadias: no newborn circumcision; surgery 6-12 months.
critical_points.zh: 尿道下裂/上裂：新生兒不可包皮環切；6-12個月手術。

critical_points.en: After hypospadias repair, no urine for 1 hour must be reported (stent kink/obstruction).
critical_points.zh: 尿道下裂術後1小時無尿須通報（支架扭曲或阻塞）。

critical_points.en: Bladder exstrophy: cover mucosa with nonadherent plastic wrap/sterile nonadherent dressing; no petroleum jelly.
critical_points.zh: 膀胱外翻：以無菌不沾黏敷料/塑膠膜覆蓋黏膜；勿用凡士林。

mnemonics.zh: Epispadias 的 Epi＝上方（背側）；Hypospadias 的 Hypo＝下方（腹側）。

mnemonics.en: GN = 'hypertensive, hematuria, high' (volume overloaded); nephrotic = 'low' (low albumin, low-normal BP, big proteinuria).
mnemonics.zh: 腎絲球腎炎＝高血壓、血尿、容積過多；腎病症候群＝低白蛋白、血壓偏低/正常、大量蛋白尿。

stem.en: Which statement by the parent of a child with suspected acute glomerulonephritis is most consistent with the diagnosis?
stem.zh: 疑似急性腎絲球腎炎孩童之家長，哪項說法最符合此診斷？

options.en: "His urine has looked like cola for two days."
"He has been urinating much more than usual."
"His blood pressure was low at the clinic."
"He had a stomach virus last week."

rationale.en: Gross hematuria (cola-colored urine) and oliguria with hypertension are classic; a strep throat or skin infection history is expected.
rationale.zh: 肉眼血尿（可樂色尿）、少尿及高血壓為典型表現；應有鏈球菌咽喉或皮膚感染史。

stem.en: The nurse is caring for a child with glomerulonephritis. Which finding indicates fluid volume overload? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 照護腎絲球腎炎孩童，哪些發現顯示體液容積過多？（複選）

rationale.en: Rapid weight gain, hypertension, venous distention and bounding pulse reflect overload. Sunken fontanel indicates dehydration.
rationale.zh: 快速增重、高血壓、靜脈擴張與洪脈代表容積過多；囟門凹陷為脫水。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A 3-year-old with nephrotic syndrome has periorbital edema, frothy urine and BP 88/54. Which laboratory finding does the nurse expect?
stem.zh: 3歲腎病症候群孩童，眼周水腫、泡沫尿、血壓88/54。預期哪項檢驗結果？

options.en: Low serum albumin and high lipids
High serum albumin and low lipids
Elevated ASO titer as the hallmark

options.zh: 血紅素低並有破碎紅血球

rationale.en: Nephrotic syndrome shows massive proteinuria, hypoalbuminemia and hyperlipidemia. Schistocytes/anemia suggest HUS.
rationale.zh: 腎病症候群為大量蛋白尿、低白蛋白、高血脂；破碎紅血球與貧血見於HUS。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: An anuric child with hemolytic-uremic syndrome is receiving peritoneal dialysis. Which action is appropriate?
stem.zh: 無尿的HUS孩童接受腹膜透析。何者適當？

options.en: Give a rapid transfusion for anemia

rationale.en: Anuria requires fluid and potassium restriction. PD uses no AV fistula and transfusions are given cautiously to avoid overload.
rationale.zh: 無尿需限水限鉀；腹膜透析不需瘻管；輸血需謹慎以免液體過量。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A newborn with bladder exstrophy is admitted. Which intervention protects the exposed bladder?
stem.zh: 膀胱外翻新生兒入院。何者可保護外露膀胱？

options.en: Sterile nonadherent plastic wrap or dressing
options.zh: 無菌不沾黏塑膠膜或敷料

rationale.en: A nonadherent covering keeps mucosa moist and allows urine drainage without damage. Petroleum jelly and dry gauze adhere and injure tissue.
rationale.zh: 不沾黏覆蓋可保持黏膜濕潤並讓尿液引流；凡士林與乾紗布會黏附損傷組織。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: After hypospadias repair with a urinary stent, the toddler has had no urine output for 1 hour. What should the nurse do?
stem.zh: 尿道下裂修補術後留置支架的幼兒，1小時無尿。護理師應？

rationale.en: No output for an hour may mean a kinked stent or sediment obstruction; report to the surgeon. Fluids are encouraged and tub baths avoided.
rationale.zh: 1小時無尿可能為支架扭曲或沉積物阻塞，需通報外科醫師；應鼓勵飲水且避免盆浴。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: The parents of a 7-year-old with nocturnal enuresis ask about the outlook. Which response is best?
stem.zh: 7歲夜間遺尿孩童的家長詢問預後。何者最佳？

options.en: It is caused by a psychiatric problem.
It does not respond to treatment.
It is usually outgrown; limiting evening fluids and voiding at bedtime help.
options.zh: 多半會自行好轉；晚間限水與睡前排尿有幫助。

rationale.en: Most children outgrow nocturnal enuresis; behavioral measures, alarms or desmopressin may help after pathology is ruled out.
rationale.zh: 多數兒童會自然好轉；排除病理原因後，行為措施、警報器或desmopressin可輔助。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: Which findings would the nurse expect in a child with newly diagnosed nephrotic syndrome? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 新診斷腎病症候群孩童預期有哪些發現？（複選）

rationale.en: Weight gain (not loss) from edema and elevated (not decreased) lipids occur.
rationale.zh: 水腫導致體重增加（非減輕），血脂升高（非降低）。
